archetypes.description: Bulletproof single-speed wet centrifugal clutch step-through moped. Simple, endlessly tunable with 70cc kits and expansion pipes, but tough up steep SF hills unless geared or clutched right.
Dual-pulley variated belt drive paired with a case-reed intake. Rockets up steep Oakland and SF hills when roller weights match your exhaust's powerband.
2-speed automatic gearbox moped combining brisk 1st-gear takeoff with tall 2nd-gear Bay Crossing speed and cast mag rims.
